title: QueryService.java is a single 691-line class
evidence: src/main/java/br/soccer/QueryService.java:334 — all match/team/player/competition/statistics queries live in one class (maintainability=0.5754 from scores.json)
suggestion: Consider splitting match, player and standings logic into separate services for maintainability; not required by the spec

title: MCP protocol and JSON are hand-rolled, not via an SDK
evidence: src/main/java/br/soccer/McpServer.java:44 serve()/handle() implement JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio directly; src/main/java/br/soccer/Json.java:1 is a hand-written parser. pom.xml declares only junit as a dependency
suggestion: Satisfies R1 (tools/list + tools/call + initialize are exposed); noted only because R1's how_to_verify mentions 'server SDK usage'. No change needed

title: Implementation exceeds the spec with 15 tools
evidence: src/main/java/br/soccer/McpServer.java:235 registerTools() registers 15 tools including team_rankings, biggest_wins, compare_seasons, derbies, knockout_stages, players_by_club and club_profile beyond the 12 required capabilities
suggestion: Enhancement beyond spec, not a deduction
